symptom: Native is self-centered, faces issues in marital life, or suffers from liver problems.
remedy: Offer water to a Peepal tree daily.
Keep solid silver in the house.
source: Lal Kitab (Original by Pt. Roop Chand)

symptom: Native faces issues with mother, vehicle accidents, or loss of property.
remedy: Feed milk to a black dog.
Keep a black and white dog in the house.
source: Lal Kitab (Original by Pt. Roop Chand)
